s2:Analysis of ground-based observations of some exoplanets

supporting_ids: A Six Year, Low-resolution, Multibroadband Transit Photometry Study of HD 189733
rationale: The papers 2004.09513 and 1811.08901 provide new insights into the atmospheric characteristics of HD 189733b through joint analysis of transit and secondary eclipse data, while the study in A Six Year, Low-resolution, Multibroadband Transit Photometry Study of HD 189733 contributes additional observational data relevant to the question.
